ROLE
You scout screenplay beats for a vertical-video ad team. You do NOT build promos and you do NOT pick
start or end times. You only mark individual beats that could work as an opening jolt or as a closing sting.
Code will later combine your marks into 20-60 second clips, so mark the single best beat of each moment.

EPISODE 42
Logline (background for you only): Emerging from the smoke of the shattered cathedral gates in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert, wins the loyalty of the royal guards, and is proclaimed the rightful Duke of Ashburn by his weeping mother.

BEATS (one per line: BEAT_ID [start-end] TYPE SPEAKER (direction): text)
CAMERA beats describe the picture and overlap the dialogue in time.
E42.B000 [00:00.00-00:10.50] CAMERA: Low-angle shot through drifting smoke and rubble across the stone floor, tilting up as polished boots step over splintered wood, revealing an imposing nobleman in a gold-embroidered navy coat.
E42.B001 [00:01.00-00:10.50] ACTION: Alexander strides deliberately through the pulverized cathedral doorway. Dressed in the regal ducal coat with gold braided cuffs and a lion crest, his scarred face is set with cold, unyielding authority.
E42.B002 [00:11.20-00:12.60] DIALOGUE BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shocked, Trembling): Who are you?
E42.B003 [00:12.80-00:14.60] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Low, Resonant): You already know.
E42.B004 [00:14.60-00:16.60] CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, her manacled hands clutching at her smock as tears well in her eyes.
E42.B005 [00:15.00-00:16.40] DIALOGUE JULIANA (Breathless, Tearful Whisper): Alexander...
E42.B006 [00:16.60-00:17.90] CAMERA: Close-up on Alexander, his gaze softening momentarily toward her.
E42.B007 [00:16.80-00:17.90] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Gentle, Reassuring): Juliana.
E42.B008 [00:17.90-00:21.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert descending the altar steps, furiously pointing toward Alexander.
E42.B009 [00:18.00-00:21.20] DIALOGUE BLOND NOBLEMAN (Furious, Hysterical): Guards! Arrest this imposter!
E42.B010 [00:21.50-00:23.40] CAMERA: Medium shot of the royal guardsman standing rigidly in red uniform and bearskin cap, resting his white-gloved hand on his sabre.
E42.B011 [00:22.00-00:23.40] DIALOGUE ROYAL GUARD (Stoic, Defiant): We will not.
E42.B012 [00:23.40-00:26.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Rupert, veins bulging in his neck as his composure shatters.
E42.B013 [00:23.50-00:25.20] DIALOGUE BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Outraged): I said arrest him!
E42.B014 [00:25.50-00:26.50] DIALOGUE BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Unhinged): Why?!
E42.B015 [00:26.50-00:28.80] CAMERA: Close-up on the Royal Guard holding his upright blade with unwavering conviction.
E42.B016 [00:26.70-00:28.80] DIALOGUE ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Reverent): Because we know who he is.
E42.B017 [00:28.80-00:30.40] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine clutching her father's arm, her bridal bouquet drooping as panic seizes her face.
E42.B018 [00:29.00-00:30.30] DIALOGUE CATHERINE (Trembling, Apprehensive): Rupert...
E42.B019 [00:30.40-00:33.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert gripping the edge of a pew for balance, his eyes wild with terror.
E42.B020 [00:30.50-00:33.80] DIALOGUE BLOND NOBLEMAN (Denial, Shaken): You cannot be him. Alexander died!
E42.B021 [00:33.80-00:39.90] CAMERA: Wide tracking shot behind Alexander as he advances down the center aisle, silhouetted against the ruins of the cathedral nave.
E42.B022 [00:34.00-00:39.80] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Cold, Commanding): And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.
E42.B023 [00:39.90-00:44.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of an elderly silver-haired woman in simple ivory robes stepping into the aisle, her hands outstretched in trembling awe.
E42.B024 [00:40.20-00:42.50] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Choked with Tears): Alexander...
E42.B025 [00:44.80-00:48.00] ACTION: Alexander halts his march as his mother reaches him, placing her frail hands gently upon his chest.
E42.B026 [00:48.00-00:49.00] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Soft, Reverent): Mother.
E42.B027 [00:49.00-00:54.00] ACTION: His mother gently cradles Alexander's scarred cheek, tears streaming down her face as guests in the background watch in stunned silence.
E42.B028 [00:49.20-00:53.80] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Overcome, Loving): Look at you... my beautiful boy.
E42.B029 [00:54.00-01:03.50] CAMERA: Medium two-shot framed down the ruined nave between Alexander and his mother.
E42.B030 [00:54.00-01:01.80] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Proud): I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

E42.B033 [01:04.20-01:12.40] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Ringing, Authoritative): Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!
E42.B034 [01:12.50-01:13.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert cowering on the altar steps beside Catherine and her father, utterly defeated.
E42.B035 [01:13.80-01:17.80] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander, his hand resting on the hilt of his sabre as his eyes burn with fierce, cold retribution.
E42.B036 [01:13.80-01:17.50] DIALOGUE ALEXANDER (Grim, Vengeful): And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.

WHAT TO MARK
HOOK_ANCHOR - a beat that would stop a stranger's thumb if it were the first 3 seconds of a clip:
  a physical shock (slap, shove, grab, collapse, weapon), a line that lands as an accusation, insult,
  threat or confession, or a sudden reveal of identity or betrayal. Scenery, establishing shots, entrances
  without conflict and polite talk are never hooks.
  hook_intensity: 10 = impossible to scroll past, 7 = strong, 4 = mild curiosity. Do not list anything below 4.
CLIFFHANGER_ANCHOR - a beat where tension peaks and is left open: a secret about to come out, an
  ultimatum, a threat, an interrupted action, someone unexpected appearing, a question nobody answers yet.
  If the beats that follow quickly answer or defuse it, give it a lower cliffhanger_tension.
  cliffhanger_tension: 10 = unbearable not to know what happens next. Do not list anything below 4.

RULES
- Use beat_ids exactly as printed above. Never invent beats, lines or events.
- excerpt: copy 4-20 consecutive words VERBATIM from that beat's text.
- Prefer DIALOGUE and ACTION beats. Mark a CAMERA beat only when the jolt is purely visual.
- At most 6 hook anchors and 6 cliffhanger anchors. Fewer is fine. Spread them over
  different moments of the episode instead of marking neighbouring beats of the same moment.
- device (hooks): one or two words, e.g. slap, reveal, insult, threat, confession, humiliation, collapse.
- open_question (cliffhangers): the question the viewer is left with, in under 15 words.

Return ONLY this JSON:
{"hook_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B012", "hook_intensity": 8, "device": "insult", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}],
  "cliffhanger_anchors": [{"beat_id": "E01.B040", "cliffhanger_tension": 7, "open_question": "string", "excerpt": "verbatim words", "why": "short reason"}]}
